messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 0.15-0 on R-Forge
messages.body_plain:
Changes in Version 0.15-0 (from the NEWS file):

  o function 'gridSearch' can now evaluate a function that expects 
    a list or a vector as its first argument
  o test cases for 'gridSearch' added  (in unitTests/unitTests.R)
  o 'DEopt' can take a vector F to set specific step sizes for each 
    decision variable (this actually worked before but is now documented 
    and tested) 
  o 'PSopt' can take a function 'changeV' and a logical 'loopChangeV' 
    (passed via the list 'algo'); 'changeV' allows to impose restrictions 
    on the velocity (see the code in directory NMOFex for an example) 
  o more checks were added in opt-functions
  o small changes in the vignettes (in particular, seeds are set now)
  o minor changes in documentation/examples

messages.subject: [NMOF-news] book website/code examples available
messages.body_plain:
A preliminary version of the book's website is now available under 
http://nmof.net . Most importantly, all the code examples given in the 
book can be downloaded from this website. The site will also inform 
about other news regarding the book; any code updates (and the 
inevitable errata list) will be posted there, too. (Important updates to 
http://nmof.net will also be announced on this mailing list.)


--
Just as a reminder, other relevant websites are:

the publisher's official website: 
http://www.elsevierdirect.com/ISBN/9780123756626

the homepage of the R-package NMOF: http://nmof.r-forge.r-project.org/

messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 0.15-4 on R-Forge
messages.body_plain:
Changes in Version 0.15-4

   o experimental: 'DEopt' takes further arguments 'storeF' and 
'storeSolutions'
     (through list 'algo'). If 'storeF' is FALSE, objective function 
values are
     not stored ('Fmat' is set to NA; see ?DEopt). If 'storeSolutions' 
is TRUE,
     all population matrices are stored for every generation. This 
should be
     helpful for diagnostic checking (and demonstration purposes), but 
may use
     up a lot of memory for larger problems; hence default is FALSE.
     (These settings will either be removed from 'DEopt' or be added to all
     opt-functions in one of the next package versions.)
